lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 552 Complaint No. 05-0157-955 File Number

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah. (nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You did? (Brendan nods “yes”) You’re 100% on that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) Yeah.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did she get in the back of the jeep? Tell us that.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you help him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Let’s be honest here Brendan. If you helped him, it’s OK, because he was telling you to do it. You didn’t do it on your own (Brendan shakes head “no”).

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I didn’t, I didn’t touch her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So you get over into the garage and the garage door is open, her truck is in the garage. Right?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”)Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And what does he say to you?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Think about it and be honest.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It’s OK. What does he say to you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That’s when he threatened me, that if I would say anything, that he like trusted me or somethin’.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why did he, why did he have you come over there? Did he need help with something? Remember we already know, but we need to hear it from you. Why did he have you come over there? He needed help, didn’t he? (Brendan nods “yes”) What did he need help with? Go ahead and tell us.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Probably to get rid of the body.
